description: Pairs every sensor with the reading at the same position
The pairs stop at the shorter list until the other one catches up
code:
names = ["ana", "bo", "cy"]
scores = [7, 9]
board = names.zip(scores)
first := board.length
scores.push(8)
[first, board]

description: A combiner multiplies prices by quantities for an order total
code:
prices = [4, 4, 2]
quantities = [3, 1, 3]
prices.zip(quantities, (price, quantity) -> price * quantity).sum()

description: A list zipped with its own tail measures the change between readings
Drivers and trucks pair up in population order as both classes grow
code:
class Driver(name):
    this.name = name
class Truck(plate):
    this.plate = plate
Driver("ada")
Driver("bo")
Truck("T1")
crews = Driver.zip(Truck, (driver, truck) -> driver.name + ":" + truck.plate)
Truck("T2")
Driver("cy")
crews

description: A live zip follows a rate that its combiner reads
code:
hours = [8, 6, 4]
rates = [20, 25, 30]
bonus = 0
pay = hours.zip(rates, (hour, rate) -> hour * (rate + bonus))
bonus = 5
pay

description: Each order pairs its items with their prices in a class-level rule
code:
class Order(items, prices):
    this.items = items
    this.prices = prices
$Order.lines = $Order.items.zip($Order.prices)
order = Order(["tea", "jam"], [3, 5])
order.items.push("bread")
order.prices.push(2)
order.lines

description: Repeated items keep their own partners
code:
grades = [4, 4, 3]
credits = [3, 2, 3]
grades.zip(credits, (grade, credit) -> grade * credit)

description: A failing combiner rolls back the push that triggered it
code:
def gap(load, limit):
    if load > limit:
        throw "OVERLOAD"
    return limit - load
loads = [3, 5]
limits = [4, 8, 6]
spare = loads.zip(limits, gap)
failure = ""
try:
    loads.push(9)
catch error:
    failure = error
[failure, loads, spare]

description: Zips nest to combine three parallel lists
code:
xs = [1, 2]
ys = [3, 4]
zs = [5, 6]
xs.zip(ys).zip(zs, (pair, z) -> pair[0] + pair[1] + z)

description: A class instance list zips with a plain list of targets
code:
class Lap(seconds):
    this.seconds = seconds
Lap(62)
Lap(58)
Lap(61)
targets = [60, 60]
Lap.zip(targets, (lap, target) -> lap.seconds - target)

description: A sequence that is not a list raises a TypeError that a try catches
code:

r = ""
try:
    r = xs.zip(5)
catch error:
    r = error
r
